actual_scope: Decide which endpoint pairs with unequal masks are joined by a monotone chain of the multiset (6,6,6,7,7,7) on s=4..18. The endpoint domain is the 2400 triples (M_4, D, M_18) from the two splits in PR7042.
scope_change_reason: The catalogue card asks for one new connector operation. This package keeps the unsigned dirty connector alphabet fixed and answers the first open question of PR7042: which unequal-mask endpoint pairs of type T1 are joined by a monotone chain. A new operation is not the missing step.
bottleneck_link: Side result on the recursive-interface schedule. It does not change a supplier, a consumer, or kappa. A complete yes means this multiset imposes no further diagonal obstruction beyond the two endpoint lemmas of PR7042.
stop_rule: Stop once every endpoint pair in the finite domain has an explicit word, or once one unequal pair is shown to have none. Do not search families T2 through T6, do not rerun the separation-3 census, and do not claim the depth-two exclusion.
evidence: Uniform construction: swaps exchange M_4\M_18 with M_18\M_4 and the remaining steps are slides. The budget identity L_j-E_j = 1_{M_4}(j)-1_{M_18}(j) makes every quota nonnegative. Exhaustive check of the finite domain: 20 splits at s=18, 120 splits at s=4, and all 2400 constructed words, of which 2280 have unequal masks. Four controls. No SAT solver was run. The unrestricted depth-two exclusion is not claimed.

open_questions.question: Which endpoint pairs of separation-3 type T2, the multiset (0,6,7,7,7,12), are joined by a monotone chain on s=4..18?
open_questions.why_it_matters: T1 is the only separation-3 family with no coordinate 12, and a 12 is fixed by every legal weight-3 step. A T2 obstruction would be a diagonal constraint that this transport does not see. A complete yes would mean the frozen 12 and the three mask coordinates can be moved independently inside that family. Either answer stays short of the unrestricted c=6 exclusion.
open_questions.first_step: Fix the frozen 12 at source 5, take start mask {0,1,2} and end mask {0,1,3}, and decide whether one explicit word keeps (0,6,7,7,7,12) at every s=4..18.
open_questions.blocked_by: The exchange used here replaces a 6 by a 7. It is not a legal step once a coordinate is 12. This package does not build a T2 word.
